subject: Invoice submission — portal vs email: edge cases, PO stamping, and sample rows
messages:
From: Michael Perez <michael.perez@brightline.example>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts@brightline.example
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice submission options & sample row

Hi Connor,

We're getting our finance team ready to submit the first invoice for order PO-45293 but we still need to know the recommended submission channel and formatting. A few quick questions:

- Do you prefer invoices uploaded to a vendor portal or emailed to an AP mailbox?
- If email is allowed as a fallback, what exact fields must appear on the PDF and in the subject line so the invoice auto-ingests?
- Is a 3-line CSV (one row per line item) acceptable for our initial trial? If so, can you share a sample row?
- Any requirements around PO stamping (e.g., do you need the PO number printed on each page)?

We want to avoid rejections once we submit. Attaching our draft PDF for context (draft-invoice.pdf).

Thanks,
Michael Perez
Senior Billing Analyst
Brightline Industrial
Attachments: draft-invoice.pdf (PDF, 235 KB)
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Michael Perez <michael.perez@brightline.example>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice submission options & sample row

Hi Michael — thanks for the clear questions and the draft. Short answer: portal is preferred for recurring suppliers; email is allowed temporarily if you follow the rules below.

Portal vs Email
- Preferred: Vendor portal (https://app.redwood.com/vendor-portal). It provides automatic PO matching and faster processing.
- Fallback: Email to ap-invoices@redwood.com is accepted while portal access is being setup, but invoices that don't meet the ingest rules will be returned.

Email ingest rules (required for PDF invoices)
- Subject line MUST begin with the PO number exactly as: PO-45293 (example). Example subject: "PO-45293 Invoice 20250629".
- PDF must include: Vendor name, Vendor remit address, Redwood PO number, Invoice number, Invoice date, Line-level descriptions, Quantity, Unit price, Total per line, Invoice total.
- Each PDF page should show the PO number in the header or footer (we call this PO stamping). If multi-page, include "Page X of Y".

CSV / line-item sample (if you send CSV instead of PDF)
- Acceptable columns (exact header names): InvoiceNumber, PO, LineNumber, Description, Qty, UnitPrice, LineTax, LineTotal, Currency, RemitAddress
- Sample row: 45293-INV0007,PO-45293,1,"Replacement valves - model ZX7",10,125.00,100.00,1350.00,USD,"Brightline Industrial, 11 Harbor Ln, Portland OR 97201"

PO stamping
- We require the PO printed on every page for mail/email ingestion. For the portal, the PO association is handled by the portal UI and file metadata; human-readable PO on the invoice is still recommended.

I'll attach our concise PO-stamp spec and a one-page CSV example. Stephanie, can you confirm TIN/tax fields? Vivek, heads up on temporary email acceptance and any discount holds.

Connor O'Brien
Senior Partner Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachments: po-stamp-spec.pdf (PDF, 28 KB), example-lines.csv (CSV, 1 KB)
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Michael Perez <michael.perez@brightline.example>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 15:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice submission options & sample row

Thanks — a couple of clarifications from AP side:

- Please include VendorTaxID (TIN) as a separate CSV column named VendorTaxID when sending CSV. We use that to validate 1099 eligibility.
- If you have multiple remit addresses (billing vs physical), include RemitAddress as the address for where checks/wires should be sent. If different, add PhysicalAddress as a secondary column.
- For invoices that represent multiple shipments against one PO, send separate invoices per shipment (we prefer separate InvoiceNumber values) rather than a single invoice with partial shipments.
- Credit memos: mark Subject with "CREDIT" and reference the original InvoiceNumber and PO. We do not auto-apply credit memos unless the PDF shows the original invoice reference.

I'll attach our updated po-stamp-spec.pdf and a sanitized CSV example that mirrors our ingestion schema.

-Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
AP Operations Lead
Redwood Inference
Attachments: po-stamp-spec.pdf (PDF, 34 KB), brightline-sample-row.csv (CSV, 2 KB)

- We have a legacy ERP that prints the vendor remit address on the first page only. Is it acceptable if the PO is stamped on each page but the remit address appears on page 1?
- For the TIN column we can provide the number but prefer not to include banking info in CSV.
- If we need the portal account mapped to our vendor code (BR-998), what's the fastest way to get that linked?

We plan to submit the first invoice via email tomorrow morning unless you advise otherwise.

Thanks,
Michael Perez

Brightline Industrial

Subject: Re: Invoice submission options & sample row

Michael — we can accept the first invoice by email as a temporary exception while the portal account is being set up. A few operational notes:

- Please ensure the PO is stamped on every page; remit address on page 1 is acceptable.
- Do not include banking credentials in CSV attachments. VendorTaxID is fine.
- We will not honor early-payment discounts until portal-based remittance & 3-way match are confirmed — AP will process under standard terms.
- To expedite portal mapping to BR-998, please complete the onboarding form (link above) and reply with your vendor code and preferred contact. I'll loop in our onboarding engineer if we need expedited mapping.

Connor / Stephanie — please track this as an exception case (Vendor onboarding: Brightline Industrial) and open a short-lived ticket so finance doesn't auto-reject.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
